title: ui2compose: An interpretable pipeline for generating Jetpack Compose code from Android UI screenshots
description: ui2compose converts an Android UI screenshot into compilable Jetpack Compose code on a laptop CPU, with no GPU, no external API and no large language model. A YOLOv8s detector, trained on a rebalanced 13-class version of the ReDraw dataset, locates the interface components; rule-based stages then remove duplicates, nest the boxes by containment, and rebuild a Row and Column hierarchy by recursive projection, which fixed templates turn into Kotlin. Every decision after detection is logged, so the position of each component in the generated code can be traced back to the rule and the coordinates that produced it. The default weights are trained on an app-level split of ReDraw, in which no app has screens in both training and test. The release includes the trained weights, a Streamlit demo, and reusable tooling for app-level splits with a leak audit, for layout evaluation, and for compile checks.
